confidence_notes: Current aggregated Koh Samui prices indicate about ฿150 for an inexpensive meal, ฿1,000 for a mid-range meal for two, ฿72 for a cappuccino, and ฿80 for a draft beer. The cocktail estimate reflects regular tourist-bar prices; wine by the glass is less certain and estimated at roughly 2.75 times local draft beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and season-sensitive.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Samui has holiday-island demand similar to Phuket and Krabi. I estimate dorms and private rooms near those comparables, with basic guesthouses and three-star hotels modestly higher to reflect island destination demand.
